title: Abba Yudan of Tzaidan, a Tanna
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He testified to a ruling in Rabbi Eliezer’s name, as in Tosefta Oholot, chapter 18. Yevamot 122a cites his testimony that a woman may remarry on the basis of a gentile speaking incidentally. In the Mekhilta of Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai, printed in HaPeles, year 3, page 707, Abba Yudan of Tzaidan says in Rabban Gamliel’s name: “From where do we learn that a person should not say, ‘I am unworthy to pray for the Temple’?” etc.

notes.text: HaPeles, year 3, page 707, is Hyman’s printed publication locator. The source quotes only the beginning of the Temple-prayer teaching.

The consulted Yevamot122a directly names Abba Yudan of Tzaidan in a case where a gentile’s incidental report allowed remarriage. The HaPeles publication locator and its exact Mekhilta wording remain Hyman’s report, without direct inspection of that printing.
